title: Sausage Egg McMuffins
description: Homemade high-protein egg McMuffins with lean turkey/chicken sausage and egg whites — freeze and microwave on busy mornings.

ingredients.text: 1g garlic powder, 1g paprika, 1g fennel seeds, salt, pepper

steps: Mix ground chicken/turkey with garlic powder, paprika, fennel, salt and pepper. Form into 6 patties.
Cook patties in oil on medium heat 3–4 min each side. Remove.
Fry or scramble eggs; season with salt and pepper.
Toast muffins. Layer: bottom muffin → sausage patty → egg → cheese → top muffin.
Wrap individually in parchment + foil. Freeze. Microwave from frozen 2–3 min.
macrosNote: Whole recipe (6 portions). Per portion: ~300 kcal, 25g protein
notes: Use light English muffins to reduce calories. Add hot sauce for a kick.
